coupling_convention: Lambda_i^-1 in GeV^-1 (inverse coupling scale, NOT canonical d_e)
notes: GEO600 GW detector search for scalar field dark matter coupling to beamsplitter via oscillations of alpha (Lambda_gamma) and electron mass (Lambda_e). Paper constrains BOTH photon coupling (ScalarPhoton-like, alpha variation) and electron coupling (ScalarElectron-like, m_e variation) simultaneously, so coupling type is ambiguous - reported ScalarPhoton but could be ScalarElectron. Values are inverse coupling scale Lambda_i^-1 in GeV^-1 (y-axis of Figs 2,3), NOT canonical d_e/d_me. Best limit Lambda_e,gamma up to 3e19 GeV (Lambda^-1 = 3.3e-20 GeV^-1) for masses 1e-13 to 1e-11 eV. Full mass range 1e-20 to ~1e-5 eV. rho_local = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (galactic halo, Basic Scalar scenario).
